text: 中国商务部公告，牛肉保障措施项下自巴西进口的牛肉于7月21日已达到商务部公告2025年第87号明确的该国家规定数量的80%。根据商务部公告2025年第87号，在牛肉进口数量达到规定数量100%的第3日起（含当日），将在现行适用关税税率基础上加征55%关税。
text_en: China Ministry of Commerce announced that beef imports from Brazil under safeguard measures reached 80% of the specified quota for that country, as per MOFCOM Announcement No. 87 of 2025, on July 21. Per the announcement, when imports reach 100% of the quota, a 55% tariff will be added on top of current applicable tariffs from the third day onward.
